title: SkyrimNet SexLab
description:
Provides the actions and prompts needed to support sexlab animations in SkyrimNet.

Details at

## Required

- SexLab Framework (vanilla or P+; P+ Separate/enjoyment-wait scenes are capped so LLM scenes end)
- Papyrus MessageBox
- JContainers v4.2.13.1+
- SkyUI SE
- UIExtensions
 - UIExtensions_UITextEntryMenu_with_VR_support (VR)
- Prisma UI
 - Media Keys Fix
- Dragonborn voice over 2
- SkyrimNet **0.25.0+** (Beta 25; narration enabled). This mod ships LLM content as plugin `goodprovider.sexlab` under `Data/SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/external/`. Older SkyrimNet builds that only read `prompts/` and `config/actions/` will not load those files.
- SkyrimNet_SexLab (this mod)
- Animation utilities: Pandora, XPMSSE, SL Animation Loader, Hug kill move fix for USSEP
- Ace Animations (cuddle/spooning)
author: goodprovider
